# Canonical quasi-experimental replication datasets

Real published datasets (no synthetic values), extracted verbatim from
their CRAN homes for the replication tests in
`tests/testthat/test-quasiex-replication.R`:

| File | Source package | Citation |
|---|---|---|
| `lalonde_matchit.csv` | MatchIt::lalonde | LaLonde (1986) AER 76(4); Dehejia & Wahba (1999) JASA 94(448) |
| `basque_synth.csv` | Synth::basque | Abadie & Gardeazabal (2003) AER 93(1) |
| `lee2008_house.csv` | rddtools::house | Lee (2008) J. Econometrics 142(2) |
| `cigarettes_sw_aer.csv` | AER::CigarettesSW | Stock & Watson (2007), cigarette demand IV |
